Abbott Undergraduate Engineering Internship Programme
4 Remaining Engineering Internship Opportunities Available
Unlock Your Potential at Abbott
Are you looking to apply your engineering knowledge, gain hands-on industry experience, and work on projects that make a real difference? Abbott's Undergraduate Engineering Internship Programme offers students the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals while contributing to innovative healthcare technologies that help people live healthier lives.
We currently have four remaining Engineering Internship opportunities available across the following Abbott Ireland sites:
Abbott Nutrition, Cavan
Abbott Diagnostics, Longford
Abbott Diabetes Care, Donegal
As an Abbott Engineering Intern, you'll gain practical experience in a global healthcare organisation, develop highly sought-after technical skills, and build valuable professional networks while working in world-class manufacturing and engineering environments.
Many of our interns go on to secure Graduate opportunities, Professional Development Programme (PDP) positions, and long-term careers across Abbott's operations in Ireland and globally.
What You Can Expect
As an Engineering Intern at Abbott, you will gain hands-on experience while supporting projects that drive innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across our manufacturing and healthcare operations.
Depending on the site and assignment, you may gain exposure to:
Manufacturing Engineering
Process Engineering
Project Engineering
Facilities Engineering
Automation Engineering
Maintenance Engineering
Continuous Improvement Initiatives
You'll work closely with cross-functional teams, contribute to real business projects, and develop practical skills that complement your academic studies.
What's in it for You?
Apply your academic learning in a real-world engineering environment.
Gain valuable hands-on experience with a global healthcare leader.
Work on meaningful projects that improve products and processes impacting millions of people worldwide.
Learn from experienced engineers and industry professionals.
Develop technical, analytical, project management, and problem-solving skills.
Build your professional network across Abbott's Ireland operations.
Gain exposure to advanced manufacturing technologies and healthcare innovation.
Benefit from a structured internship experience aligned to your academic programme.
Explore future opportunities through Abbott's Graduate Programmes and Professional Development Programmes.
Placement length will align with academic programme requirements and business needs.
About Abbott
Abbott is a global healthcare leader developing life-changing technologies that help people live healthier lives. With more than 122,000 colleagues serving people in over 160 countries, Abbott delivers innovative solutions across diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and branded generic medicines.
In Ireland, Abbott employs more than 6,200 people across ten sites, providing engineering students with the opportunity to gain experience in world-class manufacturing and technology environments while contributing to healthcare innovation.
Employment offers are subject to the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening.
Why Choose Abbott?
At Abbott, you'll gain practical engineering experience while working on projects that create real impact. You'll:
Contribute to technologies and manufacturing processes that improve lives.
Learn from experienced engineering and operations professionals.
Build valuable technical and professional skills.
Develop your understanding of highly regulated manufacturing environments.
Expand your professional network across Abbott's Ireland operations.
Explore future career opportunities within Abbott.
Our internship programme provides real-world experience, broad exposure, and a strong foundation for future engineering careers.
What You'll Bring
We're looking for ambitious students who are eager to apply their engineering knowledge in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
Successful candidates will:
Be available for a placement aligned to their academic programme requirements.
Be pursuing a degree in: Mechanical Engineering Manufacturing Engineering Automation Engineering Electrical Engineering Mechatronics Facilities Engineering Industrial Engineering or Computer Science
Be on track to achieve, or have achieved, a minimum 2.1 degree classification .
Demonstrate strong communication, teamwork, and analytical skills.
Show initiative, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
Have a passion for engineering, innovation, and healthcare.
Thrive in a collaborative team environment and take ownership of their work.
Closing Date: 20 November 2026
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews may take place before the closing date.
With only four Engineering Internship opportunities remaining, we encourage interested students to apply as soon as possible as positions may be filled before the closing date.
Join Abbott and Help Build the Future of Healthcare
Become part of the next generation of engineers helping to develop innovative products, technologies, and manufacturing solutions that improve lives around the world.
Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives: Abbott in Ireland | Benefits
Connect with us at www.abbott.com and on, Facebook , Instagram , X and YouTube . LinkedIn , Facebook , Instagram , X and YouTube .
#EarlyCareers #STEMCareers #LifeAtAbbott #FutureTalent

Apply your academic learning in a real-world environment.
Gain valuable hands-on experience with a global healthcare leader.
Contribute to meaningful projects that help people live healthier lives.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader developing life-changing technologies that help people live healthier lives. With more than 122,000 colleagues serving people in over 160 countries, we deliver innovative solutions across diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and medicines.

Employment offers are subject to the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening.
Why Choose Abbott?
At Abbott, you'll gain hands-on experience, work on meaningful projects, and develop skills that will support your future career. You'll:
Contribute to healthcare innovations that improve lives.
Learn from experienced professionals and industry experts.
Build valuable skills and expand your professional network.
Gain exposure to opportunities across Abbott's Ireland network, with flexibility to be based at different Abbott locations.
Explore future career opportunities within Abbott.
Our internship Programme provides real-world experience, broad exposure, and a strong foundation for future career growth.
Areas of Opportunity
Depending on business needs and your area of study, you may have the opportunity to gain experience in one or more of the following areas:
Supply Chain
Gaining exposure to planning, logistics, procurement, scheduling, and materials management activities that help deliver products to patients worldwide.
Specific assignments will be aligned to business requirements, site needs, and individual development opportunities
What You'll Bring
At Abbott, we're looking for students with the curiosity, drive, and ambition to make a difference. Successful candidates will:
Be available for a 6, 9, or 12-month placement aligned with their academic programme.
Be pursuing an undergraduate or postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain discipline
Be on track to achieve, or have achieved, a minimum 2.1 degree classificatio n.
Bring strong communication, teamwork, and analytical skills.
Demonstrate initiative, curiosity, and a desire to learn.
Have a passion for innovation, STEM, and healthcare.
Thrive in a collaborative environment and be willing to take ownership of their work.
Have flexibility to be based at any Abbott Ireland location, providing opportunities for broader exposure, diverse experiences, and professional growth.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will take place before the closing date. As positions may be filled early, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid missing out on this opportunity.
